author: Salem Techsperts
description: This is why it's so important to keep your BIOS updated. The early version of this ASRock Motherboard had issues regulating voltage on certain AMD CPU's. In 2026, we're in the age of hardware instability, where manufacturer's release fixes monthly for an issue that should never have existed in the first place. So it's important to make sure your BIOS is always updated.
title: He Dropped His PC and Broke The BIOS? 🤔 #pc #tech #technology #computer
